description: Compute mean, median, modes, range, sum, count, population and sample standard deviation, plus an optional separately weighted average. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

values.description: 1–1000 finite values in a common unit.

items.description: Measured value in the common data unit, between ±10^12.

weights.description: Optional one weight per value; at least one positive weight. Weights affect only weightedAverage.

name: average_calculator

outputSchema.description: Unweighted descriptive statistics, modes array (empty when no repeats), sample SD (null for one value), weightedAverage/weightSum (null without weights), and formula.

title: Average Calculator
